data.description: Vendetta Online is a cross-platform 3D space combat MMORPG, allowing thousands of players to interact as the pilots of spaceships in a vast universe. Users may build their characters in any direction they desire, becoming rich captains of industry, military heroes, or outlaws. A fast-paced, realtime "twitch" style combat model gives intense action, coupled with the backdrop of RPG gameplay in a massive online galaxy. Three major player factions form a delicate balance of power, with several NPC sub-factions creating situations of economic struggle, political intrigue and conflict. The completely persistent universe and detailed storyline add to the depth of immersion, resulting in a unique online experience.

changelog.change_log:
- Added an arrow to the station interface in the Training sector to direct players to the Missions menu.
- Added support for more fonts for most European languages.
- Small tweaks for some translations for Russian, German, Spanish, and Ukrainian.
- Fixed issue with 'Docking...' incorrectly appearing.
- Bug fixes

- Preliminary "beta" localized client text support for 20 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Chinese Simplified, Chinese Traditional, Korean, Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Hindi, Bengali, and Arabic.
- More Missions are now localized into more languages.
- Improved in-client tutorial voiceovers are available in a subset of languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish, Russian, Polish, Chinese (Mandarin), Korean, Japanese, Hindi, and Arabic.
- Other mission voiceovers may use platform-specific text-to-speech in local languages, with varied quality (we cannot store high-quality voiceovers for all missions, the game would be too large of a download).
- TRANSLATION CAVEATS: "Full" localization only extends to the game-client and initial mission tutorials. Some missions are translated after that, into a few languages, but not yet all languages. Not all Client content is localized, and some interfaces have layout issues with long word-lengths. Machine translation has been temporarily used for some languages, and may be less than ideal. Again, this is a "beta" localization update.

- Auto-detection of Quest 3S, with improved default graphical settings.
- Fixed crash in the graphics driver.
- Fixed rendering issue with missing shadows on certain ships.
- The range of the Cargo Tractor Beam for non-capships has been extended to 15 meters, acceleration increased to 80 m/s^2, and an extra conic tractor region has been added to the front of the ship.
- Improved alignment of name text under 2D selection box on the HUD.

- Added Quest 2/3/Pro controller meshes.
- Added a text notification on the HUD when a crate is picked up that shows what was picked up and how many units. It can be disabled in  Options -> Advanced -> Interface -> HUD Settings -> Show HUD notification when item is picked up.
- Fixed issue with infinitely repeating crate pickup sound.
- Improved the line width of the 2D selection boxes on the HUD.
- Fixed issue with collision sound effect being played when picking up cargo in space.
- Fixed issue with '?123' button on the in-game touch keyboard not always displaying the numeric keypad.
- Improved crash reporting, to help us react more quickly to future issues.
- Added more logging to track down existing bugs.

- Auto-detection of Quest 3, with improved default graphical settings.
- Workaround for recent, rare issues with Quest devices, where the app loses focus on startup.
- Workaround for Quest lifecycle bugs apparently introduced by a recent Horizon OS update.
- Improved crash reporting for the Quest version, to help us react more quickly to future issues.
Bug fixes, updated assets to latest version.
